description: This file defines a React functional component named `FileView` which manages the display of a file with conditional overlays based on application state and user permissions. It interacts with application context, view controllers, and protection mechanisms, rendering either a protected overlay or the file contents without protection.

classes.name: FileView
classes.description: React functional component managing display and protection overlay logic for a file within the application.

methods.name: dismissProtectedOverlay
methods.description: Asynchronous callback to handle dismissing the protection overlay, possibly requesting authorization to view file contents.
